name: Auburn University
cycle_quote: For summer and fall 2027, admission decisions will be released in rounds.

prompts.text: Activities and Interests Form: Share up to 20 of your high school activities, interests, leadership opportunities, and work experience. Reporting activities can help Auburn better understand your life outside of the classroom.
prompts.quote: Auburn offers two optional forms for applicants to provide additional information about their experiences inside and outside the classroom.

prompts.text: Additional Academic Achievements Form: Share additional academic information that you would like us to consider when reviewing your application. This could include Advanced Placement (AP) scores, dual enrollment coursework, research, and more.
